sloka: विमानात् तु सुसम्क्रम्य प्राकारम् हरि यूथपः ।हनूमान् वेगवान् आसीद् यथा विद्युद् घन अन्तरे ॥५-१३-१॥
transliteration: vimānāt tu susamkramya prākāram hari yūthapaḥ ।hanūmān vegavān āsīd yathā vidyud ghana antare ॥5-13-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the vanara leader, jumped from the aerial chariot to the boundary wall like a flash of lightning in the clouds.
